question: In a certain code language, 'DISK' is written as 'SIKD', and 'MINE' is written as 'NIEM'. How will 'BOLD' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'DISK' is written as 'SIKD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fcef16060ee21560a3c0dc3b8714b41e19c4f171b72fd68537b36c2e95abb0d.png] 

'MINE' is written as 'NIEM'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50939898e12d1cf5ca0e57341d5c4daf0787e13dca213fae216debe780bedca3.png] 

Similarly, for 'BOLD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/600186e64f86ebb4a0b90fa0f30fc08f6d94fbf90e418ac7e2a96be10db5d8fb.png] 

So, 'BOLD' will be written as 'LODB'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
